svg.title: Four exact stages of a singular value decomposition
svg.desc: A equals the two by two matrix with rows three one and one three. The same colored input points pass through V transpose, a stretch by four and two, and U, with U and V rotations of forty five degrees. A red unit input along X reaches the vector three one. Axis scales differ between the first two and final two panels.

g.text: The same input directions, through every stage of the SVD
A has rows (3, 1) and (1, 3). U = V = a positive 45° rotation. Colored points keep their identity.
